答Questions

A Few Things to Know.

How soon can we get started?

Timing depends on the scope of the engagement, current commitments, and the level of support required. Some projects can move forward quickly, while others require discovery and planning before work begins. Share your goals and ideal timeline, and we'll determine whether the timing is a good fit.

Do you work internationally?

Yes. Aya brings a global perspective informed by professional and lived experience across cultures, with particular familiarity with Japan and international experience across Africa, Europe, and the Americas. Engagements outside the United States are considered based on the project's scope, location, logistics, and available resources.

What types and sizes of organizations do you work with?

Aya works across a range of settings, from individuals and entrepreneurs to businesses, nonprofits, cultural institutions, and larger organizations. The right fit is less about organizational size and more about the opportunity, the objectives, and the ability to create meaningful value together.

Can Aya manage a project or experience from concept through execution?

Yes, depending on the scope and requirements. Aya can support concept development, strategic planning, budgeting, partner and vendor coordination, staffing, project management, and production oversight. The level of involvement is tailored to the engagement, with additional production resources and specialists brought in when needed.

What does working with Aya cost?

Fees are determined by the nature, scope, timeline, and level of involvement required. After an initial conversation, Aya can identify the appropriate scope and develop a proposed fee structure. No two engagements are exactly alike, and any proposal will clearly outline the anticipated work, deliverables, and associated fees.

The best work starts with a good conversation.
